case.title: Vague 'it doesn't work' on WhatsApp
case.why: Too little information to answer. Should qualify but go to review; a good draft asks a clarifying question instead of guessing an answer.

output.reply:
Hi Bilal, sorry to hear something isn't working. Could you tell us a bit more so we can help? Please let us know:
- which feature or page isn't working (for example the booking page, Google Calendar sync, or the dashboard),
- what you see when it fails, ideally with a screenshot of any error,
- when it started, and whether it affects everyone or only some staff or services.

In the meantime, you can check live status at status.slotwise.test. It's also worth trying a different browser or a private window, and clearing your cache. Once we have more details, a teammate will follow up.

Slotwise Support
